name: supermodels
description: Call Claude Code, Google Antigravity, and Grok Build from Codex for independent code review and task delegation.

interface.shortDescription: Use external coding agents as adversarial reviewers from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Supermodels lets Codex ask Claude Code, Google Antigravity, and Grok Build for independent reviews over one immutable snapshot with losslessly paginated diff and changed-file evidence, or delegate bounded tasks through their native CLIs while preserving local provider auth and artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Use supermodels:review to review the current working tree.
Use supermodels:adversarial-review to ask Claude Code, Antigravity, and Grok Build for a strict review.
